feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: RSS or Atom feed URLs (e.g. "https://techcrunch.com/feed/"). One lookup is billed per feed.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return posts published within this many days of today.

maxResultsPerFeed.title: Max posts per feed
maxResultsPerFeed.description: Maximum number of posts to return per feed, most recent first.
